psychological_meaning: Gravel, a muted and earthy gray, evokes feelings of stability, resilience, and grounding. It suggests a sense of quiet strength and dependability, reminiscent of natural landscapes and enduring materials. Gravel can also represent practicality and a lack of pretension.
